description: The Activity Timeline is a searchable history of everything captured on screen during automation. Users search by typing natural language queries (e.g., 'login button disabled') and the page returns relevance-ranked results from a PostgreSQL full-text search index. Each result shows a text preview, capture source badge, app name, timestamp, and optional URL. Data is populated automatically by three background capture sources and is filtered for PII before storage. The page serves as the primary debugging tool for answering 'what was on screen when X happened?'

assertions.description: Required element 0 for state Architecture and Data Pipeline

target.label: Required element for Architecture and Data Pipeline

groups.description: The Activity Timeline is backed by a PostgreSQL table (activity_timeline) with 6 indexes including a GIN full-text search index on to_tsvector('english', text_content). The table is created automatically on PgDb startup via ensure_tables() in database/pg/mod.rs. Queries are generated by Clorinde from queries/activity_timeline.sql with nullable field annotations. The PgDb wrapper (database/pg/activity_timeline.rs) handles SHA-256 content hashing and 30-second deduplication window via find_recent_duplicate(). Search uses PostgreSQL plainto_tsquery + ts_rank for relevance ranking, capped at 50 results with 500-char LEFT() previews. Three data sources feed the timeline: (1) BackgroundObserver (TypeScript, ui-bridge/ai/background-observer.ts) — captures UI Bridge semantic snapshots every 10 seconds with SemanticDiffManager change detection, circuit breaker after 10 consecutive errors, started from App.tsx useEffect with 5-second delay; (2) Python bridge (gui_automation.py) — emits activity_timeline_capture events after each GUI action containing real accessibility tree text (walked recursively with 200-depth guard), intercepted by EventForwarder::handle_timeline_capture() in executor/events.rs; (3) BackgroundCaptureService (Rust, recording/background_capture.rs) — tokio background task for periodic black-box desktop captures with in-memory content-hash dedup.
groups.name: Architecture and Data Pipeline

assertions.description: Required element 0 for state Privacy and Content Filtering

target.label: Required element for Privacy and Content Filtering

groups.description: All text content is filtered before storage by ContentFilter (recording/content_filter.rs). PII scrubbing uses 7 regex patterns: email addresses → [EMAIL], credit card numbers (starting with 3-6) → [CREDIT_CARD], SSNs (###-##-####) → [SSN], bearer tokens → [BEARER_TOKEN], OpenAI-style sk-* keys → [API_KEY], GitHub ghp_* tokens → [GITHUB_TOKEN], and generic api_key/access_token patterns → [REDACTED_KEY]. Sensitive window detection skips capture entirely for 11 password manager applications (1Password, KeePass, KeePassXC, Bitwarden, LastPass, Dashlane, Enpass, Keeper, NordPass, Credential Manager, Keychain Access) and incognito/private browsing windows. The filter is applied in two locations: the insert_activity_entry Tauri command (commands/activity_timeline.rs) via a OnceLock<ContentFilter> singleton, and the Python event interceptor (EventForwarder::handle_timeline_capture in executor/events.rs) via a separate OnceLock instance. When a sensitive window is detected, the Tauri command returns -1 without storing.
groups.name: Privacy and Content Filtering

assertions.description: Required element 0 for state Implementation Details

target.label: Required element for Implementation Details

groups.description: Frontend: ActivityTimelinePanel (React, components/activity-timeline/ActivityTimelinePanel.tsx) uses useState for query, results, stats, loading, searched, showFilters, appFilter, sourceFilter. Search invokes Tauri command 'search_activity_timeline' or 'search_activity_timeline_filtered' depending on filter state. Stats fetched via 'get_activity_timeline_stats'. Results rendered as bordered cards with color-coded source badges (blue=ui_bridge, green=accessibility, amber=ocr). The component is lazy-loaded in TabContent.tsx. Tab ID 'activity-timeline' registered in tab-types.ts. Sidebar item in qontinui-navigation/src/groups.ts under OBSERVE_ITEMS with Activity icon and #06B6D4 cyan color. BackgroundObserver service (services/background-observer-service.ts) wraps BackgroundObserver class, calls getGlobalRegistry().captureSnapshot() for control snapshots, and invokes insert_activity_entry Tauri command to persist captures. Hash computation uses crypto.subtle SHA-256 with FNV-1a fallback for non-secure (HTTP) contexts.
groups.name: Implementation Details
